facts.fact: Tilde 去看丈夫，第一次没有那种恐惧的紧箍，但仍感到 kithwood 的搏动
facts.anchor: When I went to see my husband, it was the first time I did not feel the clench of fear

facts.fact: 她仍听得见 Hadiah 的哭声，也仍感到 Marolyn 冰冷的手压在自己手下
facts.anchor: I could still hear Hadiah’s sobs

facts.fact: 她断定 Elise 看见了、知道了，因此不信任她，认定必须做点什么
facts.anchor: Elise had seen, Elise knew. And I did not trust her. Something had to be done.

facts.fact: 她独自走进天鹅王的寝殿，殿里挂帘闭着，草药烧得又甜又呛
facts.anchor: I went alone into the swan king’s chamber.

facts.fact: 只要天鹅肝还够，Ziyan 每天往他的补药里滴一滴即可，不必再烧 glory
facts.anchor: Ziyan could slip a daily drop into his tonics

facts.fact: 国王认不出名字，只叫她「妻子」这个被给予的头衔
她问国王是否愿意服从她、替她复仇
facts.anchor: ‘Will you obey me then, and give me retribution?’

facts.fact: 国王答「是，我的王后」，把服从交了出去
